intro.title: Compression & caching
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple Express server that uses compression and caching to improve performance. You will learn how to reduce the size of responses sent to clients using the compression middleware and how to cache static files to speed up repeated requests. The main technologies involved are the Express framework, the compression middleware, and the built-in static middleware with cache headers. By the end, you'll understand how these techniques optimize web applications for faster loading and better user experience.
intro.usecase: Compression and caching are essential for optimizing web application performance, especially in data-heavy products like e-commerce platforms and content management systems. For example, an e-commerce dashboard displaying real-time sales analytics benefits from caching API responses to avoid redundant database queries, while compressing product images and JSON payloads reduces page load times. Similarly, a news website with high traffic uses caching for frequently accessed articles and compression for text content to serve users faster. These techniques are crucial for improving user experience, reducing server load, and lowering bandwidth costs in production environments.
